osaka_panaf_african_restaurant_club.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog says allergy information is available. Rice dishes, stews and grilled meats are the places to ask; fried shrimp in kataifi, fritters, bread and pita are wheat-based.
osaka_panaf_african_restaurant_club.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options, but the buffet is centred on meat stews, kebabs and fried seafood and the dishes are not labelled in reviews.
osaka_panaf_african_restaurant_club.hours_raw: Sun–Thu and holidays 11:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); Fri and Sat 11:00–22:30 and then as a club from 22:30 to 05:00; closed over the New Year (Tabelog). Buffet from 2 October 2026: lunch 11:00–15:00, ¥2,000 for 90 minutes (¥2,500 with soft drinks); dinner ¥3,800 for 120 minutes (with soft drinks ¥4,500, alcohol ¥5,500, craft beer ¥6,500); an African beer-garden course on the terrace ¥5,000 (Tabelog). Live music every day, from about 20:00 (Tabelog; October 2026). Reservations (Tabelog); the entry queue can be slow (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 200 seats with sofas, a counter and a terrace; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English menu and English-speaking staff; kids menu (Tabelog). Opened 24 March 2026 (Tabelog).
osaka_panaf_african_restaurant_club.notes: [African · Amerikamura, the Expo's African restaurant, now a buffet with live music] The African restaurant that drew crowds at the 2025 Osaka Expo, reopened on the 7th floor of Big Step in Amerikamura and since October 2026 a buffet: ¥2,000 at lunch, ¥3,800 at dinner, with a terrace and live African music every night. Try the peanut-rich mafe stew, Kenyan kebab, kataifi shrimp and the rice dishes, and a baobab or bissap juice. Diners in 2026 found it great value and fun; some found the entry queue disorganised, the soups sour or the popular dishes gone at peak times. On Friday and Saturday nights it turns into a club until 5:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: an African buffet restaurant with live performances, blending traditional African culture with contemporary flavours, with dishes that were a hit at the Expo; buffet from 2 October 2026; opened 24 March 2026. October 2026 reviewers describe it as the African restaurant from the Osaka Kansai Expo.
chef_bio.philosophy: Refined African dishes that break the stereotype of Africa (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "I especially loved the Mafe, a rich beef stew made with peanut butter, which had a wonderful buttery aroma." — October 2026, buffet with craft beer ¥6,500.
"The performers shared stories about their country's culture." — October 2026, the ¥2,500 lunch with drinks.
"There was a long line at the reception. It felt more like the operation was not well organized rather than a shortage of staff." — October 2026, Saturday lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): PANAF' African Restaurant & Club、アフリカ料理・ビュッフェ・ダイニングバー、西心斎橋1-6-14 BIG STEP 7F、Shinsaibashi 駅8番出口・Yotsubashi 駅5番出口から徒歩3分、日〜木・祝 11:00〜23:00、金土 11:00〜22:30・22:30〜5:00、年末年始休み、10月2日からビュッフェ (ランチ2,000円90分、ソフトドリンク飲み放題つき2,500円、ディナー3,800円120分、ソフトドリンク4,500円・アルコール5,500円・クラフトビール6,500円)、テラスのビアガーデンコース5,000円、毎日ライブ、カード・電子マネー・QR可、200席、テラス、禁煙、車椅子可、英語メニューと英語を話すスタッフ、アレルギー表示、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアンメニュー、キッズメニュー、2026年3月24日オープン、万博で人気の料理。口コミ(2026年10月): ケニアのケバブ、チェブジェン風の牛と野菜のご飯、タジン、ピーナッツバターの牛シチューのマフェ、豆と肉のトマト煮、ミートボール、カダイフ巻きのエビフライ、魚のフリット、唐揚げ、ヨーグルトのデザート、バオバブやビサップのジュース、受付の行列、スープが酸っぱい、料理がなくなるという声も。

osaka_yamatoya_honten_shimanouchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi is the plainest; fugu kara-age, sukiyaki and the sauces are wheat or soy based. The shop takes requests for children's meals (Tabelog).
osaka_yamatoya_honten_shimanouchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, fugu, kue, Kobe beef and Ise lobster kaiseki.
osaka_yamatoya_honten_shimanouchi.hours_raw: Daily lunch 11:00–16:30 (last lunch order 14:00) and dinner 17:00–21:30 (last order 20:00); open all year (Tabelog). Reservations; groups of 15–16 or more by phone; rooms for two hours (Tabelog). Kaiseki courses: Umai kaiseki ¥6,600, Ookini course ¥7,700, Tenkomori with fugu, Kobe beef and Ise lobster ¥13,200 (Tabelog). BYO drinks allowed; children's lunch sets and meals on request (Tabelog). Fully private rooms for 2 to 100; smoking only in a separate area (Tabelog). Menus in English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese and Korean, and staff who speak them (Tabelog).
osaka_yamatoya_honten_shimanouchi.notes: [Kaiseki · Shimanouchi, seasonal Kansai kaiseki by the Dotonbori River] A large Japanese restaurant (and inn) on the Dotonbori River just across Nipponbashi, with fully private rooms for anything from two to a hundred guests, popular for company trips and New Year parties. Courses follow the season: kue hot pot in winter, hamo in summer, Kobe beef, fugu, and a ¥13,200 boat-platter feast of fugu, Kobe beef and Ise lobster. Diners praise the sashimi and the private rooms; several found the service rushed or ordinary for the setting, and one found the abalone disappointing (July 2026). Menus in four languages; lunch and dinner daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: by the Dotonbori River, serving seasonal dishes from carefully selected ingredients so guests can taste Kansai's "shun"; rooms for groups of 2 to 100. An April 2026 reviewer describes staying at Yamatoya as a ryokan with a public bath; June 2026 reviewers came on a company trip.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; fugu and kue hot pots.

anecdotes.text: "I was particularly impressed by the Kue hot pot, which had a superb broth and wonderfully tender texture." — December 2024, the kue kaiseki at lunch.
"The MVP was the flounder wrapped in paper." — June 2026, a company trip.
"We also had abalone, but it tasted more like tokobushi." — July 2026, a company-trip dinner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 大和屋本店 (やまとやほんてん)、日本料理・ふぐ・かに、島之内2-17-4、Nippombashi 駅6番出口から徒歩3分、道頓堀川沿い、毎日11:00〜16:30 (昼の L.O.14:00)・17:00〜21:30 (L.O.20:00)、年中無休、予約可 (15名以上は電話)、個室は2時間、旨い会席6,600円 (鯛の薄造り、和牛すき焼きの小鍋)、おおきにコース7,700円 (神戸牛の炙り寿司)、天こ盛り13,200円 (ふぐ、神戸牛、伊勢海老)、2〜100名の完全個室、分煙、持ち込み可、子ども向けのランチセット、英語・中国語 (繁体字・簡体字)・韓国語のメニューとスタッフ、関西の旬、春は神戸牛、夏は鮎と鱧。口コミ(2024年12月〜2026年7月): クエ鍋の会席と雑炊、鱧会席8,800円、神戸牛の会席、ふぐのコース (刺身、唐揚げ、鉄板焼き)、刺身の盛り合わせ、カレイの紙包み焼き、旅館としての滞在、社員旅行、接客が慌ただしい・普通、アワビがトコブシのようだったという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Chinese (traditional and simplified) and Korean, with staff who speak them (Tabelog).

osaka_osteria_pantera_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The fresh pasta, focaccia, pizza, lasagna and gratin are wheat-based; carpaccio, the fruit, prosciutto and burrata plate and the steak are where to ask.
osaka_osteria_pantera_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options; the reviewed dishes are mostly cheese, seafood and meat.
osaka_osteria_pantera_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 10:30–23:30: lunch 10:30–15:00, dinner 15:00–23:30; irregular closures (Tabelog). October 2026 diners give 08:00–23:00 with breakfast coffee and focaccia sandwiches. Reservations; cancelled if unreachable 30 minutes after the time (Tabelog). Lunch course from ¥2,000 with fresh pasta and unlimited bread (Tabelog; October 2026); weekday short course ¥3,800, Pantera course ¥5,000, special course with domestic beef fillet ¥7,200 (Tabelog). Over 50 wines; a sommelier (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR including Alipay (Tabelog). 34 seats with sofas; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi and outlets; children and strollers welcome; English menu and English-speaking staff; takeaway (Tabelog). Tabelog gives the opening day as 3 October 2025; an October 2026 diner says it reopened on 26 September 2026.
osaka_osteria_pantera_shinsaibashi.notes: [Italian · Shinsaibashi, an all-day osteria by Daimaru] A stylish osteria a minute from Daimaru Shinsaibashi, open from morning to late night, with fresh pasta at lunch and small plates and over 50 wines in the evening. Start with the four-cheese and honey focaccia and the fig, prosciutto and burrata plate, then a porcini or tomato-cream fresh pasta and the beef steak with porcini sauce. Lunch courses start at ¥2,000. Diners in October 2026, after it reopened, praised the food, the room and the help with surprise celebrations. English menu.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: fresh pasta at lunch and small plates and meat dishes with over 50 wines in the evening; courses for gatherings and dates; a sommelier. An October 2026 diner says it reopened on 26 September 2026 and now opens from 8:00 for breakfast.

anecdotes.text: "Osteria Pantera, an Italian restaurant in Shinsaibashi, has reopened on September 26th." — October 2026, gratin, carpaccio and steak.
"The pasta had a unique texture that I haven't experienced elsewhere" — October 2026, arrabbiata.
"They now offer a more affordable and casual lunch course, and it seems the menu has changed a bit since my last visit." — October 2026, pizza and fresh-pasta lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Osteria Pantera、イタリアン・パスタ・創作料理、心斎橋筋1-3-10 心斎橋井上ビル 1F、Shinsaibashi 駅5番出口から徒歩1分、Nagahoribashi 駅7番出口から3分、毎日10:30〜23:30 (ランチ10:30〜15:00、ディナー15:00〜23:30)、不定休、予約可 (30分連絡がなければキャンセル)、生パスタのランチコース2,000円から、平日のショートコース3,800円、パンテーラコース5,000円、国産牛フィレのスペシャルコース7,200円、50種以上のワイン、ソムリエ、カード・電子マネー・QR可、34席、禁煙、Wi-Fi、電源、子ども・ベビーカー可、英語メニューと英語を話すスタッフ、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアンメニュー、テイクアウト、オープン日は2025年10月3日。口コミ(2026年10月): 9月26日にリニューアルオープン、朝8時から、4種のチーズとはちみつのフォカッチャ、季節の果物と生ハムとブッラータ1,680円、ホタテの炙りカルパッチョ1,280円、エビとホタテのグラタン2,000円、国産牛のステーキのポルチーニソース2,980円、エビのトマトクリーム2,300円、ポルチーニのクリーム、アラビアータ、ラザニア、トリュフ塩のポテト、アフォガート。

osaka_tachizushi_sugio_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sushi comes with soy sauce, and some pieces are brushed with sauce (October 2026).
osaka_tachizushi_sugio_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and fish bar.
osaka_tachizushi_sugio_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–02:30 (last order 02:00); closed Sunday; the third Monday from 17:00 only; holiday hours by phone (Tabelog). A lunch service on Monday to Saturday is mentioned by a July 2026 diner but not on Tabelog. No reservations (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay accepted; ¥275 charge (Tabelog). 43 places, 10 at the counter, mostly standing; non-smoking; no children (Tabelog). Osaka City premium vouchers accepted (Tabelog).
osaka_tachizushi_sugio_nishinakajima.notes: [Sushi · Nishinakajima, a standing sushi bar open past 2 a.m.] A bright, lively standing sushi bar in an alley near Nishinakajima-Minamigata, where the chefs make each piece in front of you and you order one at a time, from ¥132 (Tabelog). The rice is small and the toppings big, so you can try many: uni, akami, three kinds of salmon, then ikura and rolls (2026). Start with a beer and the homemade milk tofu or some grilled fish (2026). It is open until 2:30, a favourite last stop before the final train (September–October 2026). Opinions vary on value; some found it pricey for the quality (July 2026). Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog shop text: a casual standing sushi bar two minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, where skilled chefs make authentic sushi in front of you with attention to freshness, thickness and preparation of the toppings. Reviewers: reliable, lively service (July 2026); a known spot in the area for years (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Freshness, thickness and preparation of the toppings (Tabelog shop text).

anecdotes.text: "The rice is on the smaller side, which is a great point because it allows you to enjoy a variety of toppings in small portions!" — October 2026.
"One of the dishes I was looking forward to was the 'homemade milk tofu'." — June 2026.
"It's great that they're open until late, allowing me to stop by for a quick delicious bite before the last train!" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 立ち寿司 杉尾 西中島店、立ち食い寿司・海鮮・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島3-19-7 第一ユヤマビル、西中島南方駅から徒歩2分、月〜土17:00〜翌2:30 (L.O. 2:00)、日休み、第3月曜は17時から、予約不可、カードと PayPay 可、チャージ275円、43席 (カウンター10)、禁煙、子ども不可、大阪市のプレミアム商品券可、店の紹介: 気軽な立ち寿司で本格的な寿司、職人が目の前でにぎる、ネタの鮮度、厚み、仕込みにこだわる、1貫132円から。口コミ (2026年6〜10月): 細い路地の明るい店、シャリは小さめでネタは大きい、ウニ、赤身、サーモン3種、マグロ、アジ、いくらの軍艦、巻物、おまかせのにぎり、焼き魚、ねぎと海苔をのせた赤身の刺身、自家製の牛乳豆腐、生ビール、Asahi SUPER DRY の瓶、日本酒、夜おそくまで開いているので終電前に、昼の営業もという声、値段のわりにという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing counter; order piece by piece from the chef. No English evidence found.

osaka_komeya_cocoya_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The rice itself is plain, but dishes include kara-age, chicken nanban, mapo curry and shumai, and many use koji or rice flour (shop site).
osaka_komeya_cocoya_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat and fish dishes; pork miso soup.
osaka_komeya_cocoya_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:45) and 15:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 15:00–23:00; closing days vary. The shop site gives lunch Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 (not on holidays) and dinner Sun–Thu 15:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), Fri–Sat 15:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); lunch resumed 15 October 2025. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards and QUICPay accepted; ¥400 charge, included in courses; the ¥1,000 lunch price is for cash (Tabelog; September 2026). 26 seats, semi-private areas with roll curtains; smoking allowed, so no children (Tabelog). Opened 3 April 2004 (Tabelog).
osaka_komeya_cocoya_nishinakajima.notes: [Izakaya · Nishinakajima, an izakaya where the rice is the star] An izakaya near Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open since 2004, run around rice: the owner, a certified rice taster, chooses the grain, and it is cooked in a clay pot to order, glossy and sweet (shop site; 2026). Pair it with 40–50 junmai sakes and dishes made for rice, such as salt-koji kara-age, chicken nanban and the house mapo curry (2026). Lunch is a ¥1,000 kara-age and pork-soup set; dinner courses run about ¥4,500 (2026). Smoking is allowed, so no children.

chef_bio.background: Shop site: COCOYA (※米屋) is an izakaya themed on enjoying rice; the owner is a certified rice and taste appraiser (米・食味鑑定士) and buys rice selected at a five-star rice meister's shop in the city; the rice is cooked in a clay pot made for rice; 40–50 junmai sakes; the mapo curry was featured on Kansai TV programmes in 2019. Opened 3 April 2004 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: The appeal of rice beyond plain white rice (shop site).

anecdotes.text: "Most importantly, the star of the meal, the white rice, is cooked for 30 minutes after ordering, reflecting their dedication." — September 2026, pork kara-age and tonjiru set for JPY 1,000.
"Towards the end, they served glossy white rice cooked in a pot." — October 2026.
"The Mapo Curry was also incredibly tasty, and I couldn't put my chopsticks down." — October 2026, lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: とにかく米にこだわる店 ※米屋、居酒屋・創作料理・カレー、大阪市淀川区西中島3-6-6 ヴェルフォーレ、西中島南方駅と南方駅から徒歩3分、月〜金11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:45)、15:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、土・日・祝15:00〜23:00、予約可、カードと QUICPay 可、チャージ400円 (コースは込み)、26席、ロールカーテンの半個室、喫煙可のため子どもは不可、2004年4月3日オープン。店のサイト: お米を楽しむ居酒屋、米・食味鑑定士の店主が五つ星お米マイスターの店で選んだ米、炊飯専用の土鍋で炊く、純米酒40〜50種類、糀や米粉の料理、麻婆咖喱、ランチは月曜〜金曜11:30〜15:00、夜は日〜木15:00〜23:00、金・土15:00〜24:00。口コミ (2026年9〜10月): 注文から30分かけて炊くつやつやのごはん、塩糀の豚から揚げと豚汁の定食1,000円 (現金)、Ryukyu の豚汁の定食とマグロの漬け1,500円、麻婆カレー、「Niku Nakajima」コース10品4,500円 (飲み放題2,000円)、牛しゃぶサラダ、馬刺しユッケ、つくねハンバーグ、目の前でバーナーであぶる肉、塩糀から揚げ、ごはんのサラダ、麻婆豆腐、焼売、チキン南蛮。

cultural_comfort.note: Book for courses; smoking allowed, no children. No English evidence found.

osaka_kawakita_shoten_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Skewers come with salt or sauce; the menu has kara-age, chicken nanban and croquettes.
osaka_kawakita_shoten_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori izakaya.
osaka_kawakita_shoten_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–23:00 (last order 21:45) on Tabelog; reviewers say it opens at 11:00 (October 2026). Happy hour 11:00–18:00, drinks from ¥290 (October 2026). No reservations (Tabelog). AMEX, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Counter seating; non-smoking (Tabelog). Busy at about 18:30 on weekdays, a short wait (October 2026). Opened 20 October 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_kawakita_shoten_shin_osaka.notes: [Yakitori · Shin-Osaka Station, mince skewers and a long happy hour] A busy yakitori counter in the food hall by the subway exit at Shin-Osaka Station, popular with travellers killing time before the Shinkansen, thanks to a happy hour from 11:00 to 18:00 with drinks from ¥290 (October 2026). Order the signature Kawakita mince skewers, coarse chicken with crunchy cartilage, five for ¥590, with salt or the richer sauce (2026). Lunch is a generous chicken nanban set for about ¥1,100 (2026). One diner found the skewers uneven when the kitchen was busy (September 2026). Open daily to 23:00.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 20 October 2021 (Tabelog). An August 2026 diner also mentions the brand's KITTE Osaka shop.

anecdotes.text: "The sauce version of the Kawakita Mince was richer, while the salt version had a light flavor with plenty of cartilage, making it satisfying to eat." — October 2026.
"Drinks are only JPY 290! And the happy hour lasts from 11 AM to 6 PM, which is quite generous!" — October 2026.
"The indulgence of the Chicken Nanban is incredible, and the homemade tartar sauce is absolutely delicious." — October 2026, chicken nanban and egg-over-rice set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 川北商店 新大阪店、焼き鳥・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島5-15-5、新大阪駅の中の新なにわ大食堂、毎日10:00〜23:00 (L.O. 21:45)、予約不可、AMEX・電子マネー・QR 可、カウンター席、禁煙、2021年10月20日オープン。口コミ (2026年8〜10月): 地下鉄の出口のすぐ外、となりは魚屋スタンドふじ、11時から18時までハッピーアワーでドリンク290円、名物「Kawakita Mince」(粗い鶏ミンチと軟骨、塩かタレ) 5本590円、Ooyama の鶏のもも、ねぎま、鶏皮、レバー、玉ねぎ、焼き鳥5本の盛り合わせ790円、パリパリの鶏皮は持ち帰りも、Ooyama の鶏のから揚げ、刺身3種盛り880円、「Infinite Green Peppers」390円、牛すじコロッケ、ランチはチキン南蛮と卵かけごはんか小さなそぼろの丼と鶏スープで約1,100円、KITTE の店も、混む時間は串がいまひとつという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Station food-hall counter used to travellers. No English evidence found.

osaka_ngon_ca_phe_shin_osaka.gf_detail: Ask. Pho is made with rice noodles, but no source covers the broth seasoning or cross-contact; banh mi is wheat bread. Tabelog says allergy information is available.
osaka_ngon_ca_phe_shin_osaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken pho, banh mi with meat or omelette, fish dishes.
osaka_ngon_ca_phe_shin_osaka.hours_raw: Daily 6:30–22:00 (last order 21:00); open all year; between 6:30 and 10:30 it may not always take guests (Tabelog; shop site). No reservations on Tabelog; the shop site takes online bookings and orders. Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 78 seats, sofa and semi-private areas; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children and babies welcome; free Wi-Fi; takeout and Uber Eats (Tabelog; shop site). Allergy information available (Tabelog). Opened 2 March 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_ngon_ca_phe_shin_osaka.notes: [Vietnamese · Shin-Osaka Station, banh mi and pho by the Shinkansen gate] A big, airy Vietnamese café a minute from the Shinkansen central exit, open from 6:30 to 22:00, with banh mi and pho from a Vietnamese chef (shop site). The banh mi has a light, crackling roll; one regular calls it the best they know, and the pho is clean and comforting with cilantro and lime on the side (2026). Breakfast is a ¥1,680 banh mi and pho set with a self-service salad and drinks bar; later, try Vietnamese iced or salt coffee or a Saigon beer before your train (2026). Wheelchair accessible; allergy information available.

chef_bio.background: Shop site: "ngon" means delicious in Vietnamese; a Vietnamese chef recreates authentic banh mi and pho; the coffee is chosen by bean and roast and brewed with a Vietnamese filter; breakfast includes a Japanese tray with pickles from the company's own farm. Opened 2 March 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Vietnamese food with the ease of a café (shop site).

anecdotes.text: "The bread is perfectly crispy yet chewy, and the balance of ingredients inside is outstanding." — September 2026, banh mi.
"The fried catfish banh mi had a great accent from the pickled daikon." — August 2026.
"My first experience with Vietnamese coffee indeed had a slight bitterness, but the sweet aroma was delightful." — September 2026, Vietnamese iced coffee.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ベトナムカフェ＆ビア ngon ca phe、ベトナム料理・カフェ・サンドイッチ、大阪市淀川区宮原1-1-1 新大阪阪急ビル 3F、JR 新大阪駅の新幹線中央口から徒歩1分、毎日6:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、6:30〜10:30は案内できないことも、無休、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、78席、禁煙、車いす可、子ども・赤ちゃん可、Wi-Fi、テイクアウト、アレルギー表示あり、2021年3月2日オープン。店のサイト: ngon はベトナム語で「おいしい」、ベトナム人シェフのバインミーとフォー、ベトナムのフィルターでいれるコーヒー、朝は和食膳 (自社農場の野菜の漬物) とエスニック朝食セット、ヨーグルトコーヒー、塩コーヒー、Uber Eats、ネット予約。口コミ (2026年5〜10月): 朝のバインミーとフォーのセット1,680円 (サラダ、ドリンク、ミニデザートはセルフ)、フォーとミニカレーのセット1,500円、ミニフォーのセット、ナマズのフライのバインミー、Saigon Special のビール、夜のお得なセット (フォー、生春巻き、タピオカ)、ベトナムのアイスコーヒー、パクチーは別添え、新幹線の前に便利。

cultural_comfort.note: Station café used to travellers; digital menu; allergy information available. No English evidence found.

osaka_wasshoi_fukushima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Oden in dashi, tempura and fried dishes, sushi with soy sauce; Neapolitan spaghetti is on the menu.
osaka_wasshoi_fukushima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood, oden in dashi, beef.
osaka_wasshoi_fukushima.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30, last entry 23:00); closed Wednesdays (Tabelog). Charge ¥300; no service charge (Tabelog). No minors, no soft-drink-only guests; private hire for 16 or more, not on Fridays and Saturdays (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 18 seats: 6 at the counter and three tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog).
osaka_wasshoi_fukushima.notes: [Izakaya · Fukushima, mackerel bo-zushi and oden] An eighteen-seat izakaya in a former bar above a ramen shop north of JR Fukushima, whose star is an extra-thick grilled mackerel bo-zushi, two pieces for ¥550, with a matching wagyu nigiri seared on the rice side. Around it come market sashimi, rich-dashi oden, sake-lees sausage and a deep list of local sake; a ¥5,000 course includes two hours of drinks. Business travellers and locals alike call it great value, and the master and staff see guests off at the door. No minors; smoking allowed; open to midnight, closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a space that was once a bar; fresh seafood from the market daily; signature oden with a rich dashi; local sake from across Japan; the extra-thick mackerel sushi and the grilled wagyu nigiri seared on the rice side. A September 2026 diner describes a tough-looking master who bows deeply when seeing guests off.

anecdotes.text: "The mackerel sushi is so good that I could eat it forever once it's served." — September 2026.
"A serving of sashimi was under JPY 1,000, and I could try two pieces of nigiri for comparison." — August 2026, a solo visit after 10 pm.
"Exploring Osaka's Fukushima area, I discovered a restaurant where the bōzushi is far superior to the traditional battera." — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Welcoming to solo diners (August 2026). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_kakure_niku_bar_homura.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Steak comes with salt, wasabi, a soy-based and a red-wine sauce; courses include a Caesar with croutons, pasta and fries.
osaka_kakure_niku_bar_homura.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef steak bar; mocktails are available.
osaka_kakure_niku_bar_homura.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Sun and holidays 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Tuesdays (Tabelog). Opened May 4, 2026 (Tabelog); renewed its menu in August 2026 (2026 reviews). Service charge ¥330 (Tabelog). With the à la carte drinks plan, at least two dishes per person (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 12 seats: 8 at the counter and a table for 4; heated tobacco only, in a designated area (Tabelog; 2026).
osaka_kakure_niku_bar_homura.notes: [Steak · Umeda, Kamiyama-cho, a hidden twelve-seat meat bar] A small meat bar in a leisure building in Kamiyama-cho, opened in May 2026 and reworked in August, serving thick chunk steaks of domestic beef, sirloin cap and top sirloin, with salt, wasabi or two sauces, under the eye of a hotel-trained chef. The ¥5,000 renewal course with all-you-can-drink, salad, appetizers, steak, a chunky Bolognese and sorbet, drew strong reviews, though several came from invited visits; the regular ¥6,000 course ends in beef hitsumabushi. Steaks à la carte are about ¥2,000 per 100 g. ¥330 service; heated tobacco only; closed Tuesdays.

roles: Head chef (unnamed), from the Marriott group per 2026 reviews; Tabelog says a chef from a renowned hotel supervises
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a meat bar for premium Japanese beef steak and gyu hitsumabushi, with downlights and wood; the best domestic beef from farms across Japan; dishes supervised by a chef from a renowned hotel; desserts supervised by a pastry chef. Opened May 4, 2026. 2026 reviews: the menu is supervised by a chef from the Marriott group; a renewal course from August; one September 2026 reviewer was invited to try the course.

anecdotes.text: "It's quite rare to find domestic beef steaks for under JPY 2000." — September 2026.
"The pasta (Niku Bar Bolognese, JPY 1,210) featured chunks of meat instead of ground meat." — October 2026.
"For the main course, the steak can be enjoyed with four types of sauces: salt, wasabi, soy sauce-based, and wine-based" — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Attentive staff; comfortable for solo diners (September–October 2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_horumon_no_taniguchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The hot pot broth is soy sauce or miso based, finished with noodles or zosui; fried tofu with sweet soy sauce, shrimp mayo.
osaka_horumon_no_taniguchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: offal, minced pork and clam hot pot.
osaka_horumon_no_taniguchi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and days before holidays 17:00–24:00; closed Sundays (Tabelog). Bookings cancelled 30 minutes after the time without contact (Tabelog). Seating fee ¥250 (Tabelog). Opened June 1, 2023 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay (Tabelog). 14 seats at tables (four for 4, three for 2); private hire 10 or more; smoking allowed and no one under 20 (Tabelog).
osaka_horumon_no_taniguchi.notes: [Hot pot · Nakatsu, Taiwanese-style offal hot pot] A fourteen-seat tavern a minute from Nakatsu Station, opened in 2023 by a cook with twenty years of making motsunabe, built around one dish: a Taiwanese-style hot pot of domestic horumon, long-simmered Taiwanese minced pork and clams in a soy or miso broth, spiced from level 1 to 5, with the staff assembling it at the table after you grill some fresh liver. Finish with noodles or zosui. The hot pot is ¥2,880 a head (two minimum), or ¥4,950 up with all-you-can-drink; yukhoe and braised tongue on the side. Smoking allowed, no under-20s; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): the chef has spent 20 years perfecting motsunabe, with deep knowledge of horumon; the signature Taiwanese-style braised meat of rich Taiwanese minced meat with high-quality domestic horumon; homemade thick fried tofu with a special sweet soy sauce; private hire for 10 or more. Opened June 1, 2023.

anecdotes.text: "The liver served at the beginning was seasoned and easy to eat, without any unpleasant bitterness." — August 2026.
"It felt like a combination of Taiwanese ramen and meat hot pot." — September 2026.
"It's also incredibly convenient that the staff prepares the hot pot for you!" — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain and assemble the hot pot (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_cafe_uesutan_fukushima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sweets include cheesecake and a toasted-bread dessert.
osaka_cafe_uesutan_fukushima.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and cold brew; milk drinks, cream-topped Einspänner and dairy desserts make up much of the menu.
osaka_cafe_uesutan_fukushima.hours_raw: Mon–Wed 10:00–20:00; Fri 20:00–23:30; Sat 8:45–17:30 and 20:00–23:30; Sun 8:00–18:00; closed Thursdays; hours may change (Tabelog). The Friday and Saturday night hours are a "night café" (January 2026). Opened March 21, 2013 (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; March and September 2026). 18 seats: 10 at the counter and two tables for 4; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). A December 2025 diner saw foreign guests and believes there is an English menu.
osaka_cafe_uesutan_fukushima.notes: [Café · Fukushima, house-roasted coffee by day and night] An eighteen-seat coffee café in a quiet lane north of JR Fukushima, open since 2013, where the owner roasts the beans and brews through flannel: a strong standard Colombian, the house Nishida Blend, and an Einspänner with cream and a dusting of pepper that regulars return for, hot or iced. Sweets are old-fashioned, a cheesecake with chunks of cheese, toast with cream and ice cream. Concrete walls and wood furniture; on Friday and Saturday nights it reopens as a night café until 11:30 pm, and it fills when concerts end at The Symphony Hall nearby. Cash only; closed Thursdays.

chef_bio.background: Reviews: coffee from beans roasted by the owner; the original Nishida Blend is popular; on Friday and Saturday nights it becomes a "Night Café" open until 11:30 pm (January 2026); house-roasted, flannel-drip coffee (September 2026). Opened March 21, 2013 (Tabelog). The Tabelog listing is not shop-maintained.

anecdotes.text: "Moreover, the pepper sprinkled on top of the cream adds a delightful accent." — December 2025, the Einspänner.
"As mentioned on the menu, the cheesecake is packed with chunks of cheese, making it quite satisfying." — March 2026.
"For those who love strong coffee, this place is perfect!" — September 2026, after a concert at The Symphony Hall.

cultural_comfort.note: A December 2025 diner saw foreign guests and believes there is an English menu; unconfirmed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (not shop-maintained); reviews dated through September 2026.
